rationale: Valley Cold is one current Ridgewood/Fund II cold-storage and logistics platform, not a new owner period. Ridgewood announced the investment on December 3, 2024, later described it as a Q4 2024 founder-led recapitalization, and still marks it Unrealized. The current company site labels Clay and Jennifer Bush as owners; their percentages and Ridgewood's exact stake remain nonpublic and should not be inferred.
recommendedChanges: Keep one canonical Valley Cold Storage & Transportation record and one Ridgewood ownership period beginning in 2024.
Normalize the manager to Ridgewood Infrastructure and attribute the investment to Ridgewood Fund II without inventing an acquisition vehicle or exact close date.
Retain Clay and Jennifer Bush as current founder owners with undisclosed percentages if founder ownership is represented in the data model.
Correct the platform history from a 2020 origin to establishment in 2008 and the Las Cruces warehouse opening in 2010.
Keep warehouses, transport operations and internal holding entities inside the single platform boundary.
unresolvedQuestions: Exact legal close date, acquisition SPV and control percentage
Exact founder percentages and any co-invest allocation
Full relationship among Valley Cold Storage & Transportation, LLC, VCST entities and the uncorroborated Inc. terms-page reference
fieldCorrections: Do not add a duplicate Ridgewood owner period
Do not convert Clay or Jennifer Bush's owner titles into inferred percentage stakes
Use Q4 2024 as close precision and December 3, 2024 as announcement date
